messages:
selena: Hey team — planning a 95-day remote sabbatical in Dubai from Sep18 to Dec12. Keeping US homebase but wanted to confirm WFH stipend treatment, payroll withholding, and if 95 days triggers anything around employer presence. any quick guidance?

omar: Welcome question! Dubai sounds awesome :sun_with_face: Two things up front: submit a Temporary Remote Location (TRL) so payroll can pro-rate the stipend and notify legal. 95 days is just over our usual 90 threshold so legal will want to review.

selena: ok i'll submit TRL TL-6001 in a sec. curious if the stipend gets paid in USD while I'm there or if it could convert to AED if homebase changes.

payroll-bot: Ticket created: #PR-8022 — "Dubai 95d: TRL, payroll & employer-presence check for selena" — assigned to leah-legal. ETA 2 business days. :ticket:

leah-legal: taking a look. quick clarifying q: will you remain on US payroll and not open a local bank account? also any planned meetings with UAE-based customers or contractors?

selena: yes to US payroll, no local bank, and no meetings with local customers or vendors — purely personal sabbatical, remote work only.

leah-legal: good context. UAE generally doesn't have personal income tax, but employer presence rules can be nuanced. since this is 95 days we need to confirm whether local authorities might consider a taxable or reporting touchpoint for the employer, esp. if stays exceed 90 consecutively. i'll run with local counsel.

omar: payroll note: if you keep homebase=US and payroll in USD, stipend continues but is pro-rated by calendar days in-month. if you switch homebase to UAE (unlikely for 95 days) payroll conversions, local withholding, and benefits mapping would apply.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: TRL form is under Benefits -> Location Changes. Attach flight/rental and set explicit start/end dates to trigger proration and ticketing.

selena: submitted TL-6001 with flights and short rental confirmation. added note that I won't be meeting anyone locally.

payroll-bot: Update on #PR-8022 — TL-6001 received, leah-legal assigned and requested local counsel review. status: awaiting legal.

leah-legal: also flagging a couple of operational items: 1) we generally do not ship company hardware overseas — you'll need to take your laptop; 2) we can pre-authorize a one-time internet/connection stipend up to $150 for documented short-term setups (submit receipts as expense).

selena: perfect. will take the laptop and will likely request the internet stipend. any effect on health coverage while in UAE?

omar: Redwood plans cover emergency care internationally; routine local care is not covered. telehealth should work but check provider hours vs Dubai timezone. consider travel insurance for non-urgent care.

leah-legal: last item: please avoid client meetings while on TRL. if local counsel asks for additional attestation (e.g., signed statement you won't be contracting locally) we'll ping you.

selena: noted. thanks everyone — appreciate the quick checks. TL-6001 done.

payroll-bot: #PR-8022 last updated 2185001190: awaiting local counsel (leah-legal).
